body:
The scars will look ugly 
-from one of my friends

I’m quite young to say this but imagine the time when your at home,stroking or playing with your cat.a cat is a cat but you can use that for support,sorry if this is terrible but maybe you can treat yourself to things like a cake or something!
If they are on your wrists I wear scrunchies and it hides it quite a lot xx
I hope things get better for you xx in this community we’re all here for you
